case.summary: Case HHG-005 was initiated after transaction 3523199 for $100.07 on card C02923-K1 triggered a risk score of 0.54. The online transaction occurred on 2016-12-07 21:38:37 from a new iOS device not previously associated with the account. Upon verification, the cardholder successfully completed step-up authentication and confirmed the purchase. The transaction was deemed legitimate, and the device was added to the customer's profile.

next_best_actions.what_changed: The initial recommendation was to verify the transaction and monitor the card due to the risk score and new device. The final recommendation changed to allowing the transaction and closing the case after the customer successfully completed step-up authentication and confirmed the purchase.
